verses.mystical_translation: The poem imagines blessing widening until many peoples can rejoice.
The poem enters through blessing, nations, earth, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.
Its center asks what becomes possible when fear, power, memory, and relationship are held in the presence of the Divine rather than acted out automatically.
